answer: Each key must solve a key-specific proof-of-work puzzle consuming a nonrefundable 2^40 hash budget; N fake identities cost N×2^40 hashes linearly, even if renamed. The registrant pays CPU cycles, verified on-chain by the puzzle solution binding the key hash. This irreversible loss is not capital lockup: no stake returns. A walnut on a dune costs the same crystal proof per key.
